meaning:
ἱεροπρεπής, -ές
(ἱερός, πρέπει) [in LXX: 4Ma.9:25 4Mac 11:20 * ;]
suited to a sacred character, reverend (RV, reverent): Tit.2:3 (cf. Tr., Syn., § xcii).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: and that older women likewise be reverent in behavior, not slanderers nor enslaved to much wine, teachers of that which is good,
